subject.title: fix: active-memory recall fails with billing rejections on subscription-only Claude CLI setups

question: Should `CliBackendPlugin.subscriptionAuthDispatch` plus `runtime.agent.resolveCliBackendDispatchEligibility` become the permanent generic contract for subscription-auth embedded-run dispatch?
rationale: The patch is correct and proven, but it expands plugin and runtime API surface across auth, billing, process execution, and timeout policy; repository policy requires an owner to confirm that permanent boundary.

options.title: Approve the provider-owned seam
options.body: Land the current generic capability and shared resolver, with Active Memory as the first explicit opt-in caller.

options.title: Keep the seam private
options.body: Rework the fix so Anthropic and Active Memory coordinate through a narrower internal contract without expanding the plugin runtime API.

options.title: Fold into broader helper routing
options.body: Pause this PR and incorporate the behavior into the canonical CLI-backed helper-routing design tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57326.

recommendation.title: Approve the provider-owned seam
recommendation.body: Land the current generic capability and shared resolver, with Active Memory as the first explicit opt-in caller.
